Export-grade cartons are manufactured and invoiced by our Export Packaging Division, which bills in US dollars. For the 5-ply export carton CP-028 (BF 24, two-colour with shipping marks) our price is USD 0.74 per piece. The 7-ply moisture-resistant export carton CP-029 is offered at USD 1.93 per piece, and the heavy-duty pallet-fit carton CP-030 at USD 4.13 per piece.
